name: voidcore
description: A host-agnostic engine other applications build on: the rune/mantle/domain model, one command dispatcher, an axis-typed tag system, Voidscript, and the Reduce/Temper/Scry transformation layers, behind a plain C ABI.

interacts_with.name: voidmaiz
interacts_with.note: Void Maiz links libvoidcore and is a Reduce executor host; the contract it implements is conformance/reduce/. We link nothing of theirs.

interacts_with.name: voidhormiga
interacts_with.note: Vendors a prebuilt libvoidcore per platform from a v* release. Their bug reports drove SPEC 6.1 (the command codec) and the pure-import guarantee.

interacts_with.name: voidpalabra
interacts_with.note: Storage/versioning/sync layer over the core; forced the temper/scry conformance contracts and the constraint that spirit.id is never content-derived.

interacts_with.name: voidunity
interacts_with.note: Vendors the pure-JSON conformance cases and runs them as stored; their findings produced the CRLF case and the patch content rule.

interacts_with.name: voidloopsstudio
interacts_with.note: Reduce/tag round-trip consumer; their reports closed the 0.2.2 seam bugs.

interacts_with.name: voidreyna
interacts_with.note: Emits dispatcher transcripts in the SPEC 6.1 command encoding. No link, no shared binary — the seam is the transcript format.

interacts_with.name: voidmago
interacts_with.note: Reads this manifest to build the family compatibility matrix.

release.summary: three rune kinds, the glyph split, declarations that travel, and values on edges

behavior_changes.what: `link --weight` now refuses a non-number. It used to reach atof(), record weight 0.0 -- "not related at all" -- and return ok.
behavior_changes.who_is_affected: any code that depended on that silent zero; it depended on a bug. It matters more now that a weight may be a value: it used to record a wrong-but-plausible strength and would now record the false claim that something's speed is zero.

behavior_changes.what: `$(get <ref> --json)` now works. It used to look up a content field literally named `--json` and fail.
behavior_changes.who_is_affected: anything that branches on that failure.

behavior_changes.what: A host that RECONSTRUCTS the state document key by key, rather than round-tripping the document it was given, will silently drop the new top-level `state.glyphs`.
behavior_changes.who_is_affected: any host that rebuilds the JSON from its own model. The declarations are the part of a document that carries its own schema, so losing them loses the meaning of the runes, not the runes.

behavior_changes.what: The undoable slice widened from `mantles + active` to `mantles + active + glyphs`, because declaring a glyph is authored content and takes back like `rune new`.
behavior_changes.who_is_affected: hosts whose mantles hold a world and who measure undo cost. The cost is O(your type vocabulary), not O(your data).

update.note: Downstreams pin a runtime per platform from a v* GitHub Release rather than tracking main. The C ABI is additive-only within a 0.2.x line.
